svg.title: GH1-E-00 Cover sheet, index and legend

g.text: Irrigation (4 drip zones), fertigation (A/B + acid on EC/pH) and climate control, 1 000 m² greenhouse
Supply 3/N/PE AC 400/230 V 50 Hz (TN-S) · control 24 V DC (PELV)
PLC: OpenPLC Runtime v4 (IEC 61131-3 ST) · remote I/O -A1 over Modbus TCP
Revision A · 2026-11-19 · first issue for review
-A1 coupler, -A1.1...-A1.7 I/O modules, -A10 PLC, -A11 switch, -A12 HMI
Converting a variable into a signal
* K for contactors and Y for solenoid valves follow panel-building practice (IEC 81346-2:2019 would use QA and MB). Feeders and field devices take the P&ID loop number: -K201/-M201 = P-201,
-Y401 = XV-401, -B202 = LSL-201. Sub-devices use a point: -A1.3 = module 3 of -A1, -K511.1 = vent open contactor.
Cross-reference /E-08.4 = drawing GH1-E-08, column 4. Contacts point to their coil; on the output sheet each coil lists where its contacts are drawn.
Wire numbers: potentials keep their name (L1, L2, L3, N, PE, +24.1 ... +24.5, 24V-S, 0V). Other wires are <sheet><nn>, e.g. 705 = drawn on E-07. A wire keeps its number through a
Terminals: -X1 230/400 V AC, -X2 24 V DC digital + safety, -X3 analog, -X4 outgoing power, -X0 PE bar. Terminal plans on E-10 and E-11.
Irrigation, fertigation and climate control, 1 000 m² greenhouse
OpenPLC Runtime v4 + Modbus TCP remote I/O
Electrical drawing set - control panel GH-1 (pump room)
